question: What lie did Gehazi tell Naaman?
options: That two young prophets had come and needed silver and clothing
That Elisha had changed his mind and wanted all the gifts
That the king of Israel needed money
That Naaman had not paid for his healing
explanation: Gehazi falsely said two young men from the company of the prophets had come and Elisha wanted a talent of silver and two sets of clothing for them.
